description: Session artifact tree construction benchmark; excludes UI rendering, tab transitions and window timing.

method.execution: One Node.js process; original and current functions measured alternately
method.before: Original sibling.find lookup plus name.localeCompare(name, 'zh-CN', { numeric: true }) per comparison
method.after: Per-sibling Map lookup plus module-level Intl.Collator('zh-CN', { numeric: true })
method.currentFunctionLoading: Read actual TypeScript source, extract buildSessionArtifactTree through the next statsCache declaration, prepend shared collator and transpile with TypeScript ES2022/CommonJS
method.input: Flat filenames file0.ts through fileN.ts; deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle using seed 0x12345678 and LCG Math.imul(seed, 1664525) + 1013904223
method.correctness: assert.deepStrictEqual(after(rows), before(rows)) outside timings for each size
method.sampleOrder: Even samples before then after; odd samples after then before
method.limitations: Single local run; machine load and garbage collection can affect timings. Measures pure tree construction only and must not be extrapolated to tab switching or UI rendering performance.
